hypothesis: Misses concentrate in small roofs below40m2 and joined rows

decision.small_building_association: supported: 32.68% of truth contributes56.05% of misses; recall .421 below40m2 vs .780 above40m2
decision.joined_building_association: supported but not dominant: exact shared-edge recall .553 vs .666 for others, only167/4441 misses. Raster-contact proxy recall .576 vs .680. Dense joined rows are not directly labelled.
decision.joint_association: Under40m2 shared-edge recall .263 vs .425 unjoined; at least40m2 .681 joined vs .783 unjoined. This is descriptive, not a causal intervention.
decision.chip_edges: No monotonic deficit: under1px recall .666 vs overall .662; interior64+px .629. Clipped areas can mix edge fragments and full roofs, so size-edge crossbins are reported.
decision.occlusion: unknown for all13156 features: publisher metadata contains only label; no invented or visual occlusion annotations

data_qualification.pixels: Main result bins use COCO raster counts; supplementary bins use continuous clipped original polygon area in pixel units
data_qualification.m2: Geodesic WGS84 area of original truth clipped to the declared TIFF chip, not guessed nominal resolution
data_qualification.adjacency: Exact boundary sharing and overlap, plus separately labelled raster-contact proxy
data_qualification.inference_reuse: 580 chips attributed from existing unambiguous count-only journals;854 partial chips replayed once, every TP and prediction count matches the frozen DEV receipt
